question.question: What Alliance Evening operations are available, does using an officer consume it, and when are cards drawn?

expected.expected_answer: Up to officer count actions in any order/repetition: Move once, Battle once, Recruit one at base, Organize remove warrior from unsympathetic clearing to place sympathy and score. Officers not consumed. After operations draw one plus uncovered bonuses then discard to five.

source_passages.quotation: **Evening:** The four military operations are **Move, Battle, Recruit and Organize**. Take **up to your number of officers** in operations, in any order and repetition. Officers stay on the board; taking an operation does not consume an officer. After operations, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard hand down to five.

answer.ruling: The four Evening military operations are Move, Battle, Recruit, and Organize. Take up to your number of officers in operations, in any order and repetition.
Officers stay on the board; taking an operation does not consume an officer.
After the operations, draw one card plus one per uncovered draw bonus, then discard the hand down to five.
